# Guillaume Marty

> AI and Python automation developer based in La Rochelle, France. Background: Network and Telecom Administrator diploma (m2i, Paris, 2016); Systems and Network Technician at Sanofi via Computacenter (2018 to 2022); Tier 2 Mac Support Technician, AppleCare, at Apple, Cork (2022 to 2025). Self-taught in AI and Python development since moving to La Rochelle in 2025. Builds AI systems and code-analysis tools in Python.

## Main project

- [GitHub Security Researcher (GSR)](https://github.com/LemonCondor/github-security-researcher): open-source tool (Python, Apache-2.0) he designed to find bugs in open-source code. Static detectors for Go (tree-sitter), reproduction of every bug with a failing test, regression tests, deterministic decision engine (LLM analysis alone can never confirm a finding), more than 500 automated tests.

## Open-source contributions (statuses checked on 2026-10-16)

Functional and robustness bugs found, reproduced and fixed, mostly with GSR:

- Kubernetes git-sync: [PR #1006](https://github.com/kubernetes/git-sync/pull/1006), merged.
- Google gVisor: [PR #15632](https://github.com/google/gvisor/pull/15632), merged.
